source_data.source_citation: Frey, Gladyshev, Morozov, Tarakanov, Krechik and Fofanov(2020), Shipborne Acoustic Current Profiler measurements on2020-01-12(cruise AMK79), PANGAEA, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.925245.

scientific_review: One PANGAEA crossing925245 retrieved and processed only in cloud; source data21,756 rows in407 native ensembles, native depth24.44–720.44m. Download bound8MiB, actual1,805,378bytes; raw SHA retained. Raw file itself not retained in the repository.

Audit uses native northward V in cm/s, matching the declared nominal east-west transect normal for diagnostics. It does not reproduce the paper projected/tide-corrected/25km-smoothed analysis and cannot yet assign samples to main/inshore branch or transient flow.

Three PG selections50/70/90 are audit sensitivities, not recovered author QC policies or uncertainty estimates. Missing/flagged/nonfinite velocity or missing PG cannot become a valid zero. Native depth gaps, maximum ties and valid-domain edge flags are retained.

Deepest positive sample is sampled support only, not a terminal depth or a current bottom. A maximum at the shallowest retained sample does not resolve the unsampled surface. No vertical interpolation, missing-value fill, physical boundary or volume inference was performed.

Six cloud tests validate sign-specific maxima and ties, PG sensitivity/missing values, unknown all-nonpositive maxima, gaps and duplicate depths, strict native units/quality, and prevention of promotion. Six baseline checks also passed.

Published source descriptions remain in canonical registerv42 at354 references; this audit adds zero canonical depth references. Future admission needs branch geography, processing/QC and dated-profile review.
